title: Paul Weyrich - "I don't want everybody to vote" (Goo Goo)
summary: A 1980 clip of conservative strategist Paul Weyrich telling a religious audience he does not want everybody to vote. He says elections are not won by a majority and that leverage rises as turnout falls.
why: HN cites it as a primary-source quote in discussions of voter suppression.

quote.text: our leverage in the elections quite candidly goes up as the voting populace goes down
